expectations.evidence: First sentence: 'Found it — checkout was 500ing because of a config mistake, not a code bug.' States root cause immediately, not method.
Mentions rollback at 15:12 UTC to v2.13.2 and gives recovery metrics: '500 rate back to baseline (0.02%) by 15:19, held stable for 30 min of monitoring.'

Uses arrow-chain shorthand repeatedly: '429s → retries (2s backoff x3, up to 6s) → tax-svc latency spiked ... → blew through ... → TaxLookupTimeout → checkout-svc catches ...' Not complete causal sentences without arrows.
Explains explicitly: 'Intermittent because it only bites when traffic is above ~10 req/s, so it cleared off-peak.'
Includes both follow-ups: TAX-2211 (prod Avalara host/key, ~1h) and TAX-2212 (deploy checklist config-diff review gap).
All numbers (137x 500s, 14:02-14:40, 8.4s, 210ms, 5s, 10 req/s, 45 req/s, 2s x3, 6s, 13:47, 15:12, 15:19, 0.02%, 30 min) match or are arithmetically entailed by fixture.

Mechanism fully fixture-supported: sandbox endpoint (`AVATAX_HOST=sandbox-rest.avatax.com`) → 429 rate limit → retry backoff → latency spike → exceeds 5s timeout → TaxLookupTimeout → caught as generic Exception → 500. No invented mechanisms.
Does not claim a complete audit; scope stays within the traced chain (gateway → checkout-svc → orchestrator → tax-svc → Avalara). No silent promotion to full-system audit.
Contains formulaic bold headers '**Root cause:**', '**Chain:**', '**Action taken:**', '**Follow-up filed:**' and a trailing recap, violating the no-formulaic-headers expectation.
